# Russ Connelly (Russell B. Connelly)

> Marine Biologist & PhD Candidate at the University of Essex specializing in native UK seahorse conservation using Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM), environmental DNA (eDNA), Structure-from-Motion (SfM) photogrammetry, and marine technologies.

## Research & Bio

Russ Connelly (published as Russell B. Connelly) is a Marine Biologist completing his PhD at the University of Essex on the non-invasive detection and conservation of native UK seahorse species (*Hippocampus guttulatus* and *Hippocampus hippocampus*) using passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) and environmental DNA (eDNA).

His broader research spans marine technology, Structure-from-Motion (SfM) photogrammetry, benthic and polar ecology (including maintained cryonotothenioid fish nesting sites in the Western Weddell Sea, Southern Ocean), scientific diving, and machine learning applications in marine monitoring.

## Education & Qualifications

- **PhD in Marine Biology** — University of Essex (Current)
  - Focus: Detection of native UK seahorse species using passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) and environmental DNA (eDNA).
- **MSD in Marine Biology** — University of Essex (2021–2023)
  - Investigated fish community composition in the Wakatobi Marine National Park and studied cryonotothenioid icefish nests in the Weddell Sea using ROV data.
- **BSc (Hons) in Marine Biology (First-Class Honours)** — University of Essex (2018–2021)
  - Awarded the University of Essex Environmental and Conservation Prize alongside 5 other academic awards.
- **PADI Divemaster & Scientific Diver** — Leading scientific diving operations and teaching underwater survey techniques across tropical reef, cold-water UK coastal, estuarine/salt marsh, and freshwater systems.

## Technical Skills & Areas of Expertise

- **Fieldwork & Diving**: Fieldwork planning and logistics, scientific diving techniques, PADI Divemaster, ROV/drop-camera survey analysis, drone operation.
- **Molecular & Acoustic Monitoring**: Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding/qPCR workflows, Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM) bioacoustics analysis.
- **3D & Spatial Analysis**: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) underwater photogrammetry, GIS, fisheries management, stakeholder engagement, citizen science.
- **Data Science & Programming**: R, Python, machine learning and AI for marine ecological monitoring.
- **Taxonomic & Regional Specialties**: UK coastal & seagrass ecosystems (Studland Bay, North Norfolk chalk reefs, Essex estuaries), Indo-Pacific coral reefs (Wakatobi), and Fishes of the Southern Ocean (Weddell Sea).
